official.deadline_note: UBC's own application portal states the deadline is November 15, 2026 at 11:59 PM Pacific Time. Required admission documents and evidence of meeting UBC's English Language Admission Standard are due January 31, 2027 for International Scholars Program applicants, which replaces the date in the 'Your UBC Application - Next Steps' email. Results are released on a rolling basis February-April.

official.status_note: The official UBC International Scholars page states 'Applications for the September 2027 are open' and that applications opened on October 5, 2026; UBC's application portal lists 'Opens Oct 5 2026 09:00 AM (PDT), Deadline Nov 15 2026 11:59 PM (PST)'.

application_method: Mid-September: decide on your academic program and campus (considered for first choice program; still select a second choice)

Late September: discuss the nomination with your school - one nominator and one teacher referee, who must be different people; a high school or registered non-profit may nominate up to two students for UBC Vancouver (including Vantage College) and one student for UBC Okanagan
Early October: submit the UBC Admissions application, then create an award application account and invite your nominator and teacher referee to complete their forms

Mid-October: gather annual income and expenses, family wealth and assets, dependents and annual school fees, sources of financial support, extracurricular information and awards; complete 4 essay questions of approximately 150-250 words each
By November 15: submit the completed award application, well in advance in case of technical difficulties
By January 31: submit required admission documents and English language evidence; January-March: complete the video interview if invited, within one week
official.application_route: Apply for admission to UBC first, secure a school nominator and teacher referee, then complete the online International Scholars Program award application at UBC's scholarship portal by November 15, 2026, 11:59 PM Pacific
official.citizenship_residency: Open to international students who will be studying in Canada on a Canadian study permit; must be entering directly from an accredited secondary school
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the award is restricted to international undergraduate students
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: No field restriction, but Bachelor of Nursing (Okanagan and Vancouver), Bachelor of Dental Science in Dental Hygiene, Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Science, Bachelor + Master of Management, dual degrees, joint degrees between UBC's two campuses, and joint degrees with other institutions are not eligible for any International Scholars Program award
official.description: The Donald A. Wehrung International Student Award is one of four need-and-merit-based awards in UBC's International Scholars Program. It recognizes outstanding international undergraduate students from impoverished or war-torn areas who have achieved academic excellence under challenging circumstances and who would be unable to attend university without significant financial assistance, and who demonstrate leadership potential and a strong commitment to making a positive impact in their communities. Applicants do not select an award; UBC automatically considers each applicant for the award categories they qualify for.
official.region: Canada (UBC Vancouver and UBC Okanagan campuses)
official.program_type: Need-and-merit-based undergraduate entrance award within UBC's International Scholars Program, requiring secondary school nomination
official.english_requirement: Must meet UBC's English Language Admission Standard by January 31, 2027; if you must take an English test, complete it early enough for UBC Admissions to receive official results by January 31. Applicants who do not satisfy the standard for direct entry may be eligible for UBC Vantage College and the Vantage One Excellence Award

applicant_utility.summary: This is a nomination-gated, need-based entrance award: you must apply for admission to UBC first, persuade your school to nominate you (each school can nominate only two students for the Vancouver campus and one for Okanagan), and then complete a separate in-depth award application by November 15, 2026 at 11:59 PM Pacific. UBC publishes no dollar figure for this award - support is set after a detailed assessment of family income, expenses, assets and dependents' school fees, so treat the value as determined need rather than a fixed stipend. Shortlisted applicants record a video interview with a one-week turnaround between January and March, and decisions roll out from February through April.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Top-of-class international school leavers from war-affected or very low-income backgrounds who can document heavy financial need and have a guidance counsellor or principal willing to spend one of the school's limited nominations on them.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your school has not already used its nomination slots for your target campus before building your plan around this award
Finish the UBC admissions application early - the award application asks you to confirm it before you can proceed
Secure two different referees: a nominator (counsellor, principal, administrator) and a teacher familiar with your intended field, and chase them weeks before November 15
Book any English test early enough for official results to reach UBC Admissions by January 31, 2027
Assemble official proof of family gross income, expenses, assets and dependents' school fees before opening the financial sections of the application
Draft the four essays (roughly 150-250 words each) around leadership and community impact, since you cannot choose which award category you receive
common_rejection_risks: Starting the application days before the deadline - UBC's portal warns late starters are less likely to succeed, and both referee forms must be complete before you can submit at all
School nomination capacity: exceeding the per-school, per-campus nomination caps (two for Vancouver including Vantage College, one for Okanagan) voids the nomination
Applying to merit-based international awards instead - the International Scholars Program and merit awards are mutually exclusive, so a misfiled application can cost you both streams
Missing the January 31, 2027 document deadline for transcripts or English evidence, which stalls the entire application
Applying to an excluded degree (nursing, dental hygiene, medical laboratory science, Bachelor + Master of Management, dual or joint degrees), which is ineligible across all four award categories
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: UBC publishes no value for this category, so budget full international tuition and fees plus Vancouver or Okanagan living costs using UBC's cost calculator until an offer states your assessed award; hold any housing application (deadline May 1) until award decisions arrive in February-April.
document_audit: Financial-need evidence must be official documentation of family gross income, expenses and assets - estimates will not survive the need assessment
English test results must be received by UBC by January 31, 2027, not merely booked by then
Transcripts or high school certificates unavailable by January 31 may be submitted as soon as available, but nothing admission-critical should wait past then
One person cannot serve as both nominator and teacher referee - the two roles must be filled by different people
The four required essays are substantive (150-250 words each); recycled generic answers weaken the leadership narrative this category is judged on
alerts: UBC assigns the award category automatically - you cannot choose the Wehrung award over the other three, so a weak leadership or community-impact record hurts you regardless of fit
The International Scholars Program and merit-based international awards are mutually exclusive; decide deliberately which stream suits you before applying
The video interview allows exactly one week to complete - keep email access open and mark UBC addresses as safe from January onward
Decisions arrive on a rolling basis from February to April, so a February silence is not a rejection - wait until early-to-mid April before making other funding plans
If you plan to live in residence, wait for your award decision before applying - the housing deadline is May 1
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply to UBC through you.ubc.ca first, then create an account in UBC's scholarship portal, invite your nominator and teacher referee, complete the financial and essay sections, and submit by 11:59 PM Pacific on November 15, 2026.
